# <span id="aanchor334"></span> About Close Groups

Lists or close groups allow users to close multiple meters together according to the close schedule requested. Whether a company uses lists or close groups is determined by how the Close Schedule Type option selected in the [FLOWCAL Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/Application/FLOWCAL%20Configuration.md) screen. "List" is the default close schedule type.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 293;height: 102;" />

Consider the following when determining whether to use lists or close groups for close schedules:

| Functionality | Lists | Close Groups |
|:---|:--:|:--:|
| A meter can only belong to one at any point in time | No | Yes |
| Datetime effective | No | Yes |
| A meter must be assigned to one during meter creation before the meter can be saved | No | Yes, if the Require on Meter Create option is enabled |

## Close Group Implementation

The process of implementing the use of close groups is as follows:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 578;height: 86;" />

After setting the close schedule type to "Close Group", the Close Groups drop-down will be available in the [Meter Editor](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/Meter%20Editor.md) and [Meter Quick Create](../../Meters/Meter%20Quick%20Create/Quick%20Create.md) screen. The [Close Schedules](Close%20Schedule.md) screen will also be set to use close groups instead of lists.

In addition to close schedules, close groups can also be used to generate reports and exports, import data, and view data. Locations can also be assigned to close groups. A Close Group tab is available in the Location Editor for liquids to allow you to close tickets associated with the location. For gas, if you associate a location with a close group and close it, all the meters within the location will be closed automatically.
